text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? Could that perhaps be what they call a "Paka Petit"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Mejiro Ardan pointed,
there was a claw machine filled with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san said she wanted this,
and it really is quite cute, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now I want one too.
If I decorate my room with it, I can look at it anytime.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...So, what do I need to do
to get this plushie?
choice_data_list: I'll show you for real, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from you, Trainer?
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall make sure
to study diligently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
